items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps oily skin feeling clean without stripping.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the skin's comfort and moisture while it stays sensitive.
A mineral SPF 50 each morning helps keep the look of marks from darkening and is gentle on sensitive skin.

response.routine_note: We have left out the 30% peel and other exfoliating acids, retinols and scrubs for now, because skin that recently finished isotretinoin can be much more sensitive, so please ask your dermatologist or prescriber when a peel would be suitable and what they suggest for your marks. Meanwhile, cleanse gently morning and night, moisturize, and apply sunscreen every morning.
